embeds.title: :Settings: Legend
embeds.description:
### 📊 Stats & Currencies
- :Diamond: **Diamond:** Useful currency for buying Guns, Fish and Skins. Source: (Mine)
- :Money: **Money:** Useful for purchasing Upgrades, obtained from destroying trees.
- :Power: **Power:** The amount of damage you do, increasing this directly increases your damage.
- :Speed: **ATK Speed:** How fast your cats attack, there is a hard cap for how fast it can go.
- :CritDamage: **Crit Damage:** Extra damage done when a critical hit occurs.
- :CritRate: **Crit Rate:** Chance to do a critical hit, maxes out at 100%.
- :Movement: **Movement Speed:** How fast your cats move.

### 💎 Gems, Items & Menus
- :Hunt: **Hunt Gems:** Used to summon Pets. Source: (Hunt)
- :Trip: **Trip Wings:** Used to send Pets on Trips, max 20, regenerates every 4 hours.
- :Green: **Forest Gem:** Used to upgrade Forest Abilities; Power, Rebirth, Skip.
- :Orange: **Desert Gem:** Used to upgrade Desert Abilities; Money, Idle Time, Skip.
- :Blue: **Glacier Gem:** Used to upgrade Glacier Abilities; Crit Damage, Movement Speed, Skip.
- :Star: **Star Gem:** Used to upgrade all Trip Abilities.
- :RaidGem: **Raid Gem:** Used to upgrade Enhance Slots.
- :Settings: **Settings:** Save and load files, contact support and adjust sound/vibrations, located top left corner
- :Daily: **Daily Login:** Bonus every day you log in, resets after 7 days, located top left corner
- :Trophy: **Leaderboard:** See how your max Main Stage compares with everyone else, try and reach the Top 30! Located top left corner

embeds.title: :Power: Main Stage
embeds.description:
-# 📖 [Main Stage FAQs](guide:faq-stages)
Defeat the trees in 3 minutes and climb Stages to unlock content and top the leaderboard.

### 🪜 Stages & Substages
Each Stage has 5 Substages, 1-1 → 1-2 → 1-3 → 1-4 → 1-5 → 2-1. Every few Stages the design of the trees change, this is purely cosmetic.

### 🌳 Tree Types
There are 3 types of trees, A, B and C. B & C Trees have approximately 2x and 3x more health respectively. The higher the substage the more total amount of trees and frequency of B & C Trees. This makes it so you will most likely fail between Substage 3 and 5. Tree health doesn't change between Substages.

### 🌟 Golden Tree
At the end of Substage 5 there is a Golden Tree with substantially increased health than regular trees, defeating this in time will move you on to the next Stage where Tree health is increased.

### 💡 Push or Rebirth?
It’s advisable to try and push your highest stage before rebirthing as that’ll increase your :Rebirth: Rebirth Gems reward, creating a snowballing effect of growth. Visually checking if you can fill the progress bar past 50% before the timer reaches halfway is a good way to speed up the last few stages of waiting.

If you’re playing actively it may be more efficient to Rebirth once it takes around 50% total time to clear a Substage. It depends on how long it’ll take to get back to your Max stage vs how much extra Rebirth Gems you get for pushing Max Stage and how long that takes. If it takes 1 hour to get to max stage and 15 minutes of slow Stage clearing for only a 5% increase in Rebirth Gems you’d be better to Rebirth early and do that more frequently.

If you’re playing mostly idle, definitely push your max stage so you can claim bigger rewards after coming back.

embeds.title: :Play: Play Stage
embeds.description:
-# 📖 [Play Stage FAQs](guide:faq-stages)
You have 1 minute to clear trees, defeating the 1st stage will unlock Guns and show the rest of the unlockable content.

:Money: Upgrades DO carry over in this gamemode, so best to do these Stages whilst you’re at Max Stage and have the highest Upgrades.

You should be able to clear the same Play Stage as your Max Stage.

embeds.title: :Boss: Boss (Stage 10)
embeds.description:
-# 📖 [Boss FAQs](guide:faq-stages)
Defeat the moving boss in 60 seconds.

:Money: Upgrades DO NOT carry over in this gamemode so play whenever suits you. This is a very good source of :Diamond: so it’s best to push these stages as often as possible.

To start you will need to anticipate the movements of the boss and follow manually. Once you have enough :Movement: movement speed from Pets and Trip Abilities you can run on autoplay and focus on dealing enough damage.

### 💡 When to Stop
The boss health increases by 5x each level so if you have less than 48 seconds after beating the boss don’t bother trying to beat it again as you won’t have enough damage.

embeds.title: :Money: Money Upgrades
embeds.description:
-# 📖 [Money Upgrades FAQs](guide:faq-upgrades-rebirth)
You earn Money from destroying trees in the Main Stage, this currency is used to upgrade 3 Money Upgrades, :Power: Power, :Speed: ATK SPD and :Money: Money. These upgrades RESET upon Rebirth.

### 📈 Priority
Focus on upgrading Power first, followed by Money and then ATK SPD.

### ⚡ Quick-Upgrade Trick
A trick to quickly upgrade without having to hold your finger down for a long time is to Save the game in the top left corner, force quit the app and come back in 1-2 minutes. This will automatically max your Money Upgrades to the highest level possible.

embeds.title: :Rebirth: Rebirth (Stage 3)
embeds.description:
-# 📖 [Rebirth FAQs](guide:faq-upgrades-rebirth)
Once you reach Stage 3-1 you can Rebirth, this resets your Upgrades and brings you back to Stage 1-1 but gives you Rebirth Gems to purchase PERMANENT upgrades. The higher your Max Stage, the more Rebirth Gems you receive.

### ⚖️ Power to Money Ratio
If at Max Stage your highest Upgrades are BELOW Lv 5000, **Power to Money Cost Ratio 5:1**
If at Max Stage your highest Upgrades are ABOVE Lv 5000, **Power to Money Cost Ratio 8:1**

Upgrade Speed evenly to Money (to be tested) until Lv600-Lv1000 then stop.

So if your Money upgrade costs 20a, your Power upgrade should cost around 100a. This will give you a rough equivalent of power boost from both Power and Money.

### ⚠️ Early Game Caveat
One small caveat is really early game when you don't have high level Guns/Skins/Fish, it might be more beneficial to lean more into Power to give you a boost in Boss Fights. This will give you more gems to get a fast boost in Guns/Skins/Fish, but as you get more of them it reduces the benefit of just focusing on Power. The point at which it no longer is more efficient will vary drastically, if you have purchased 2x Boss Rewards, focusing on Power is more important.

### :Speed: ATK SPD Hard Cap
:Speed: ATK SPD for your guns have a hard cap (once this value is reached they cannot attack any faster and extra upgrades will be useless). I reached this cap around Lv1000 however the exact point is not known. Another player had Lv300 as the cap with Z Gun.

A way to find out if you’ve hit the cap is to fight the Boss until you lose. Make note of the health and repeat 2 times to get an average. Rebirth and put all points into ATK SPD and then fight the boss again, compare you damage and if it doesn’t change then you’ve hit the cap. You can now focus all Rebirth Gems into Power and Money.

### 🎬 3x Rebirth
There is also a 3x Rebirth Ad option, this can be done once a day at replenishes at midnight. At Main Stage Lv100 you unlock a paid 3x Rebirth option after completing the Ad 3x Rebirth, this also replenishes at midnight.

### 📉 Lv 15000 Slowdown
Once you reach Rebirth Lv 15000, the amount each upgrade increases by jumps up 100-200x, so your progress will slow dramatically.

(Full calculations on how I got to the Ratios [here.](https://discord.com/channels/1541040609534410762/1547433258399305769/1551194333560963083))

embeds.title: :Gun: Gun
embeds.description:
-# 📖 [Gun FAQs](guide:faq-guns-skins-fish)
Summon and merge Guns with :Diamond:, there are 5 different type of guns that behave differently.

You can equip 3 guns, the first slot you control the cat and the other 2 create cats that follow you around.

### :Blast: Which Gun Type?
:Blast: Blast is currently the best for Main Stages (both climbing back up and pushing max stage) and Pierce for Bosses however, you are always better off merging when you can as the power gain far outweighs any small boost between weapon types of the same tier.

The only exception is when you play the Mine, Blast is the best. It can be worth keeping 3x lowest ranked Blasts you have to maximise Mine rewards.

### 🔒 Lock
This allows you to lock a Gun to prevent accidentally merging it.

### 🗄️ Vault
You can store extra weapons here to make it easier to merge weapons in your inventory. Extra slots are purchasable with diamonds.

embeds.title: :Gun: Best ZZZ Gun w/ Z Pet Update
embeds.description:
:Blast: Blast is still recommended as the 1st ZZZ Gun for new players.

With the new pet update scaling with total gun damage. Pierce now provides 2.14x more damage (~1 Stage) over Blast.

The difference is negligible compared to Rebirth efficiency.

**For new players** you will achieve ZZZ Gun first, followed by ZZZ Fish and then you will focus on Z+ Pets. So Pet skills won’t be a factor for a while, meaning you need Blast to push your Main Stage for more rebirth Gems.

**For established players**, you’ll probably already have a ZZZ Blast, spending 400K :Diamond: Diamonds to get a ZZZ Pierce is an inefficient use of Gems. You’re either better saving for the next update or focusing on Pets.

embeds.title: :Skin: Skin
embeds.description:
-# 📖 [Skin FAQs](guide:faq-guns-skins-fish)
Cosmetic Skins for your cats that also give a buff!

You do not have to be wearing the Skin to get its bonus, once you purchase it, it always provides the Power, Atk Spd and Money boost.

embeds.title: :Fish: Fish (Stage 6)
embeds.description:
-# 📖 [Fish FAQs](guide:faq-guns-skins-fish)
Summon and merge Fish to get :Power: Power, :CritRate: Crit Chance and :CritDamage: Crit Damage boosts, you get 5 free summons a day.

This is the only source of Crit Chance, once you get a SS Fish you'll almost being doing Crit Damage 100% of the time, giving a massive boost in damage.

If you click on the fish you can see what grade it is, you can also look at other fish you haven’t unlocked yet.

### 💰 Cost
A C Rank Fish costs 125 Gems after averaging % from the 200 Gem Summon.

embeds.title: :Hunt: Hunt (Stage 12)
embeds.description:
-# 📖 [Hunt FAQs](guide:faq-hunt-pets-trips)
Defeat the slimes before they reach the circle. Advance through the Substages and climb the Stages to rank in the leaderboards.

:Money: Money Upgrades DO NOT carry over in this gamemode so play these whenever suits you. Each Substage you clear will reward you with :Hunt: Hunt Gems to spend on Pet Summons.

This gamemode does take a long time to finish Stages, the good news is that each level auto plays so you can leave your phone and come back whenever you fail and collect all the rewards. It's approximately 2.5 minutes per Main Stage.

embeds.title: :Pet: Pet (Stage 12)
embeds.description:
-# 📖 [Pet FAQs](guide:faq-hunt-pets-trips)
Summon and merge Pets with either :Hunt: Hunt Gems or :Diamond:, Pets provide you with a :Money: Money and :Movement: Movement SPD boost.

You should work towards 3x XXX Pets, ensure you level them up evenly. Merge a 4th pet in your inventory to merge into your main pets.

### ⚠️ Don't Merge Your Main 3
Pet Level affects your offline idle clear rate and your Trip Gem Rewards, however they increase linearly between each level. So going from D to C will give the same amount of EXTRA Gems/Offline Speed as going from XX to XXX. That's why it's important to not merge your main 3 with each other, you will have to start at D again for your 3rd pet and actually decrease in Trip Gem Rewards and Offline Speed.

### ➡️ After 3x XXX
After getting 3x XXX pets, work towards evenly levelling up another 3x XXX to use in Trips as you’ll have excess Wings from only doing 16 hour Trips.

embeds.title: :Trip: Trip (Stage 35)
embeds.description:
-# 📖 [Trip FAQs](guide:faq-hunt-pets-trips)
Send your pets on a Trip to gain Ability Gems and upgrade your Abilities for unique bonuses.

There are 3 different locations to send your pets away on a Trip; :Green: Forest, :Orange: Desert and :Blue: Glacier. Only one location is available each day except Sunday where all locations are available.

You can start off sending 1x Pet for a 1hr Trip, you are rewarded with exp and Ability Gems corresponding to the location you sent them to. You cannot merge pets that are away on a Trip.

### :Trip: Trip Wings
As your Trip level increases you can go on longer Trips and send up to 3x pets at a time. Sending 1x pet costs 1x :Trip: REGARDLESS of the length of the Trip, making your current longest available Trip the most efficient.

:Trip: Capacity is 20 and regenerates 1 every 4 hours. There is no way to get more to start Trips other than waiting, making the longest available Trip the best.

### 📋 Trip Plan
Only do the longest Trip until you unlock the next longest one, repeat until you can do 16 hour trips with 3x Pets. This will be the best use of your :Trip:, with :Trip: regenerating every 4 hours you should have 1 spare every 16 hour trip. Save these until the Forest is available and go on 8 hour Trips.

The end goal is to always have a 16 hour trip going regardless of location and when Forest comes up, ALSO do an 8 hour trip until you’ve used up your extra :Trip:, make sure you have enough for your 16 hour trip when you’re running low on :Trip:.

### :Green: Why Forest?
Forest location is best because it adds Power AND rebirth bonuses which further boosts power. Whereas the other locations add Idle Time and Movement Speed which don’t directly increase your power.

### :Star: Trip Abilities
You can summon Trip Abilities with the Trip Gems received, the abilities you obtain are random for that colour. Lv1 Abilities require 2 copies to upgrade, this increases by 2 every level and caps at 50 at Lv25, max level 51. Bonuses increase linearly so as you get higher in levels with more copies required it becomes less efficient.

embeds.title: :Pet: Z+ Pet Spending
embeds.description:
This is as luck based as it can get, don’t be discouraged if you don’t get what’s optimal. At 450K spent and perfect luck only netted 10 Stages, this can easily be achieved with more efficient Rebirthing.

Keep in mind all the Stage boosts are temporary, as everyone gets the best combination the Stages will have levelled out again and the only determining factor will be Rebirth efficiency.

### 📋 Steps
**1.** It’s still recommended to Merge in your inventory to achieve your Top 3 pets. DO NOT use your extra 3x pets for excess wings as fuel to upgrade your Top 3 pets otherwise you’ll end up with worse Trip rewards overall.

**2.** Always :Settings: Save before merging pets, if you get a bad combination just Load and save more until you can afford to skip the bad Pet outcome.

**3.** First 2x Z Pets should be Buff and AoE to capitalise on the separate multiplicative effects. A 2nd AoE will only double damage so that can wait.

**4.** Your ZZ Pet should be Buff, if you come across another Z AoE it’s worth it to save it and save another 102800 :Diamond: to replace it as you never know how many tries it’ll take to get another one once you get a ZZZ Buff.

**4A.** If merging into your Z Buff doesn’t give a ZZ Buff you should reload, and now you have to save an EXTRA 204800 Gems to get a 2nd ZZ Pet.

**4B.** If your 2nd ZZ Pet isn’t a buff, you can try merge both ZZ Pets into a ZZZ Pet praying it’s a Buff. If not, then you have to repeat the whole process again.

**5.** After getting a ZZZ Buff you should now have 2x Z AoE. This set up is very convenient with AFKing as they all share the same cooldown timer. This greatly reduces wasted time when abilities don’t align, if you Auto the skills (Buff on the left) you won’t need to actively control.

### 💸 Upgrading Your AoE Pets
**6.** Upgrading from 2x Z AoE to 2x ZZx AoE gives ~3.25x more damage, costing at best 204800, this will also throw out your cooldown sync with ZZZ buff making Auto Active stage pushing take longer. I would not advise this for 1-2 Stages gain. Next we will look at skipping ZZ AoE and going straight to ZZZ AoE.

**7.** Upgrading from 2x Z AoE to 2x ZZZ AoE gives ~11.85x more damage, costing at best 614,400, this will STILL throw out your cooldown sync, making Auto Active pushing longer. A 11.85x damage boost is approximately 3-4 Stages.

embeds.title: :Pet: 3x Z Pets vs 1x ZZZ Gun
embeds.description:
- **150K** :Diamond: Gems for upgrading 3x XXX pets to 3x Z Pets (7-8 Stages if you get Buff/AoE/AoE)
- **200K** :Diamond: Gems for upgrading ZZ gun to ZZZ Gun for 25x DMG (4-5 Stages)
- Upgrading Pets provide 96 More :Star: gems every Triple 16hr trips over XXX pets.

embeds.title: :Mission: Missions
embeds.description:
-# 📖 [Missions FAQs](guide:faq-mine-raid)
Complete Daily missions to earn points to get Season rewards. You can get a total of 200 points a day as a F2P, enough to finish the season in 13 days (this averages out to be 12 days over a long period of time), the time limit for the season is 30 days.

A big thing to note is once you finish a season you can start a new one so if you complete all daily missions you can earn more rewards faster.

### 💡 Best VIP Pack
The first season gives you guns as a bonus between Diamond rewards, between updates the rewards change from Guns to Stars, so if you are a spender, getting the VIP pack for the 1st season with guns will be the most valuable VIP Pack you buy.

embeds.title: :Diamond: Mine (Stage 4)
embeds.description:
-# 📖 [Mine FAQs](guide:faq-mine-raid)
Destroy all the stones to earn :Diamond: in 60 seconds but your weapon only does 1 damage. You get 2 free entries per day, this can be increased to 6 with the Mine Pack Purchase.

:Rebirth: Upgrades DO carry over in this gamemode HOWEVER this is only relevant if you have not reached max ATK spd from Rebirth Upgrades.

There is a maximum of 190 gems to be earnt, blue stones give 1 gem and grey ones 0.1 gems. Weapon damage is always 1 so weapon type is more important than damage.

:Blast: Blast is currently the best weapon for the Mine.

### 🌀 Strategy
When you first start out you will not be able to get all the gems, I found going in a spiral from the inside to the outside to be most efficient. Never go back for stones if you miss a couple as you will lose more time getting those small amounts. Gravitate towards the blue stones as you spiral around and try to make sure your whole screen is filled with stones as often as possible.

embeds.title: :Raid: Raid (Stage 40)
embeds.description:
-# 📖 [Raid FAQs](guide:faq-mine-raid)
Deal as much damage to a massive stationary slime in 60 seconds, once you deplete a health bar a new one with 2.5x more health appears. Rebirth and Money upgrades DO NOT apply, this makes Gun, Skin, Fish and Trip Abilities more important to achieve a higher score.

### 📅 Weekly & Daily
Each week a different type of gun will deal 10x more damage, the order reflects what's in the Gun Codex. Each week there are missions to complete for extra :RaidGem: Raid Gems. Each day you get 2 free attempts at the Raid, 1 extra with ads and another paid attempt.

### :RaidGem: Raid Gems & Gun Slots
The more damage you do the more Raid Gems you receive, these Raid Gems can be used to upgrade each of your 3 Gun Slots to a maximum level of 20, each level providing a boost in damage. The most efficient use of Raid Gems is to focus on one gun slot until it's level 20.

### 🎲 Upgrade Odds
There is a % chance to upgrade Gun Slots and that decreases with each successful upgrade whilst cost increases. Lv1 costs 50 Raid Gems at 100% chance, Lv20 costs 1000 Raid Gems at 1% chance.

embeds.title: :Money: Real Money Purchases Guide
embeds.description:
-# 📖 [Real Money Purchases Guide FAQs](guide:faq-diamonds-real-money)
This game unfortunately does have microtransactions, it is a free game and with the current landscape of mobile games it is to be expected. There are some decent value purchases and some very expensive ones that aren't worth it. I will say if you plan on playing long term, the No Ads Purchase is almost a requirement unless you are not affected by FOMO at all.

I will be giving ratings on the value of each purchase with explanations and cost in AUD (because I'm Australian).

### ✅ Worth It
**10/10 - No Reward Ads ($14.99)**
Should be the 1st purchase and if it’s the only one then you’ve unlocked majority of the content without the hassle.
It also gives you a piggy bank that earns 1 gem/min with a capacity of 500 gems.

**9/10 - 4+ Extra Mine Entries ($9.99)**
The next best purchase, each mine with ads give 760 gems, that’s 3040 extra gems per day, forever.

### 🤔 Situational
**6/10 Bonus Reward Package 7 Days ($12.99)**
Double Hunt & Boss rewards and 1.5x Mine Rewards, very useful for a headstart with Diamonds and Hunt Gems, becomes less efficient as you get better Fish and Guns. After 1-2 times the value drops rapidly.

**6/10 - No Forced Ads ($4.99)**
You should already have No Reward Ads so this would be solely for the extra 1 gem/min that stacks with the No Reward Ads. In theory this’ll give you 1440 gems a day but with the 500 cap, you’ll lose 500 whilst you’re sleeping.
This brings the total to more 950/day keeping in mind you have to check every 4 hours rather than 8 now to reduce lost gems.

**5/10 - VIP Pass ($12.99)**
The value this pack brings is great but you’ll have to buy it every single season which can get expensive. It drops down Seasons from 12 days to 9 days.
Over 40K gems and 10K Star Gems or 35K worth of guns. It’s the next best purchase if you have the budget and need Gems.

**5/10 - Autoupgrade ($12.99)**
If you want to have you phone always on this is really useful however most people play idle games so they can check every so often.
This is handy in the higher levels as your online clear rate will almost be 2.5x more than offline clear rate. It becomes a decision if you want to transition from an idle to active game.

**3/10 - VVIP Pass ($22.99)**
You can finish the Season in 5 days but you get the same amount of rewards as VIP.

**3/10 Convenience Package 7 Days ($9.99)**
Skip Hunt & Play Stages, Skip Trip wait times and Auto Merge. More of a Quality of Life purchase, can save time not having to play Hunt Stages, best paired with Bonus Reward Package for a better headstart.

**3/10 3x Rebirth ($2.99)**
Triple your rebirth gems an extra once a day. Only worth it at higher stages when it takes several hours to reach Max Stage. Won't give you a huge advantage and can also get expensive buying every single day.

### ❌ Avoid
**1/10 - Buff Pack ($12.99)**
With No Reward Ads you can simply click the boost button and get the x3 Power, Speed and Money.
The only use for this is if you combine this with Autoupgrade so you can AFK and push your highest stage. Even then you’ll barely get an extra Stage or 2.

**1/10 - Diamond Purchases ($2.99 - $79.99)**
Compared to VIP pass you get a dismal amount of gems, avoid this one. It may be instant but this game is designed to be long term so invest your money elsewhere.

**1/10 - Step Purchases ($1.99 - ??)**
This one is objectively horrible value for money, if you want to spend a lot of money on this game, you're better off permanently buying VVIP Passes as that'll give you far better value.

**1/10 - Weekly Shop Guns ($7.99 - $59.99)**
This one is objectively horrible value for money, if you want to spend a lot of money on this game, you're better off permanently buying VVIP Passes as that'll give you far better value.

**1/10 - Trip Daily/Weekly Deals ($5.99 - $39.99)**
For the cost of a VIP Pass you can get 1750 Star Gems, which is LESS than a 16hr Trip with 3x XXX Pets. Worse is that those upgrades will barely get you a level once your abilities are above Lv15.

**1/10 Time Package 7 Days ($7.99)**
You are essentially doubling your Power for Boss & Play Stage, which might sound helpful but 2x Power can easily be obtained elsewhere. This also extends the time you have to be in the Stages for, slowing down progress in the Main Stage.

**1/10 Raid Mission Pass ($7.99)**
You can achieve a Lv20 Enhancement in 4-7 Days F2P depending on your Gun & Fish Level. You’re only saving a couple days progress.

**1/10 Enhance Stone Bank ($1.99+)**
Same reasoning as Raid Mission Pass. Can purchase 5 per week.

**1/10 Raid Ticket ($1.99)**
Same reasoning as Raid Mission Pass. Can purchase 1 per day.

**1/10 Helper Package ($5.99)**
This is completely useless, the Enhance level matches your lowest level, to get a Lv20 Helper it requires you to already have 3x Lv20 Slots. The extra Helper will give you a 33% boost in power which will give you an extra stage at best.

embeds.title: 🎮 Whale Purchases Guide — Gameplay Changes
embeds.description:
### 🎮 Gameplay Changes
**1. Rebirth Ratio**
With the 2x Rewards and Instant Clear you can forgo the 5:1 Power to Money COST ratio and focus more heavily on Power. This allows you to clear more Boss and Hunt Stages for even more rewards. The exact ratio you can aim for is unknown, once you get approximately Z Gun and Fish you'll want to bring your ratio closer to 5:1 as it'll take a lot more gems to get to the next tier.

**2. Pet Merging**
With Instant Trips you don't have to worry about Wings overflowing, this allows you to focus on a SINGLE pet, bring that up to XXX as soon as possible for maximum Trip rewards. Afterwards level up the other 2 evenly, utilsing your inventory to merge into the last 2 pets. These 2 pets will give you more movement speed.

**3. Trips**
You should be using only 1x pet for trips, taking the longest trips with your highest level pet until you unlock 16hr trips. Focus on getting Lv15 in all Skip Stage for 90% Skip, this will be sped up by purchasing Star Packs. From there focus solely on Forest, you will get the last 10% Skip Stage and then aim for Lv51 Rebirth for maximum rewards.

### 🏁 Goals
**1. Achieve 100% Skip Stage.**
Once this is complete you'll be on your way to be maximising your Active Clear Rate, allowing for you to catch up on the biggest time locked mechanic; Rebirthing.

**2. Get ZZZ Gun and ZZZ Fish**
Once this is complete Diamonds have incredibly low value, this is the point in which you can probably drop the 2x Rewards and even lower VVIP to VIP or drop completely. A 400K ZZZ Gun will only boost your power by 2x, the 3rd ZZZ Gun will be a 1.5x boost. The same follows for Fish.

**3. Rebirth Efficiently & Frequently**
Money can only get you so far, it's a boost but not a free pass to the Top 30. You will have to play actively and efficiently to catch up to those who have months of playtime ahead of you. 3x Blasts, Paid Super Rebirths and following the 5:1 and then 8:1 Ratio will be the fastest way to climb the ladder. It'll still be a slow process but you're on your way to the top!

embeds.title: :Power: Main Stage
embeds.description:
-# 📖 [Mega Guide](guide:stages-main-play-boss)
**Q: What does the Eco button do?**
A: It’s a battery saving mode.

**Q: Is the leaderboard accurate?**
A: Currently only from Rank 1000 is the leaderboard accurate, IOS is Stage 1130? And Android Stage 1171 (1/10)

**Q: Why do I see different players on the leaderboard compared to photos on Discord?**
A: IOS and Android have two separate leaderboards, names can only appear once between the two.

**Q: What is the maximum offline time?**
A: 8 hours, you can increase this by 10 minutes per level you have of the Trip Ability "Offline Buff".

**Q: Can I push new stages offline?**
A: No, offline will only get you to your Max Stage.

**Q: Is Active or Idle faster?**
A: Active, at the start of the game it is comparable. As you get 3x XXX Pets, 100% Skip Stage and 3x Blast weapons Active becomes ~ 2.5x faster.

**Q: How fast is my Idle Clear Rate?**
A: Save, force close the app and come back in 10 minutes, check how many stages you have cleared and x6 for an Hourly Clear Rate.

**Q: How do I increase my Idle Clear Rate?**
A: Rarity of your equipped pets increase your Idle Clear rate, level them up evenly for the best effect.

**Q: What is the max Idle Clear Rate?**
A: 95 Stages/Hour with 3x XXX Pets

**Q: How do I increase my Active Clear Rate?**
A: Movement speed from Pets and Trip Abilities, Skip Stage from Trip Abilities and using Blast Guns.

**Q: What is the max Active Clear Rate?**
A: 249 Stages/Hour with 3x XXX Pets, 3x X+ Blasts, 100% Skip Stage

embeds.title: :Play: Play Stage
embeds.description:
-# 📖 [Mega Guide](guide:stages-main-play-boss)
**Q: Why am I unable to clear Play Stages anymore?**
A: Main Stage upgrades affect your damage in Play Stages, ensure you tackle these when you're at your Max Stage for the highest damage.

embeds.title: :Money: Money Upgrades
embeds.description:
-# 📖 [Mega Guide](guide:upgrades-rebirth)
**Q: What should I focus on first?**
A: Power → Money → Speed, if you AFK for 30s all upgrades will be leveled evenly so it's not too critical what you upgrade.

embeds.title: :Rebirth: Rebirth (Stage 3)
embeds.description:
-# 📖 [Mega Guide](guide:upgrades-rebirth)
**Q: When should I Rebirth?**
A: Until failure if you idle often, for active players when the stage takes roughly half the timer.

**Q: How do I know I’ve hit the ATK SPD Cap?**
A: Test damage on the boss, upgrade Rebirth ATK SPD and compare damage.

**Q: What is the 5:1 Ratio?**
A: The refers to the optimal way to spend Rebirth Gems, Power COST should be 5x Money COST.

**Q: What is the Rebirth Wall?**
A: At Lv15000 Rebirth upgrades the cost increase 100-200x faster than before, making it very expensive and slowing progress dramatically.

embeds.title: :Gun: Gun
embeds.description:
-# 📖 [Mega Guide](guide:guns-skins-fish)
**Q: How do I increase my gacha chance?**
A: You can't, currently it's always 100% for D Guns.

**Q: Should I merge my guns?**
A: You should always merge your guns to the highest possible rarity.

**Q: Is gun merging random?**
A: Yes

**Q: What is the best gun to use?**
A: Blast, it performs best in Main Stages which is where you'll get most of your power from.

**Q: What's the best gun to use for other stages like Raid, Boss and Hunt?**
A: Technically Pierce is better than Blast in Raid and Boss but it's still recommended to go Blast for the boost in Rebirth rewards.

embeds.title: :Skin: Skin
embeds.description:
-# 📖 [Mega Guide](guide:guns-skins-fish)
**Q: Do only equipped skins effect apply?**
A: No, once you purchase a skin you permanently get the effects, the total can be seen at the top of the Skin tab.

**Q: Are skins worth it?**
A: Yes, every source of Power from a separate tab multiplies with another, making it extremely powerful.

**Q: I bought my skins out of order from the guide, what do I do?**
A: Add together the Skin numbers from the guide, compare that to the total if you add your skin numbers together. If you have the same number total the bonus is the same.

embeds.title: :Fish: Fish (Stage 6)
embeds.description:
-# 📖 [Mega Guide](guide:guns-skins-fish)
**Q: Should I buy Fish if I can just get free daily fish?**
A: Yes you should, daily fish will take 500+ Days to get a ZZZ, spending some gems will give a big boost in power in a much shorter timeframe.

**Q: Should I buy Fish or Guns first?**
A: Depends what Milestone you are on the [Diamond Spending Guide](guide:diamonds-earning-spending).

embeds.title: :Hunt: Hunt (Stage 12)
embeds.description:
-# 📖 [Mega Guide](guide:hunt-pets-trips)
**Q: Can I speed up Hunt Stages?**
A: Not without paying, the Convenience Package allows you to skip the Hunt Stages.

**Q: When should I complete Hunt Stages?**
A: Doing a few minutes after each rebirth can help reduce prolonged periods of Hunt Stages. Alternatively you can play it during the night whilst you sleep as you’ll only lose one rebirth.

embeds.title: :Pet: Pet (Stage 12)
embeds.description:
-# 📖 [Mega Guide](guide:hunt-pets-trips)
**Q: Should I spend Diamonds on Pets?**
A: No, you will get plenty of :Hunt: from completing Hunt Stages.

**Q: When will I get 3x XXX Pets?**
A: Hunt Stage 513 for F2P watching ads, Stage 257 if you have 2x Rewards.

**Q: Do I focus on one pet like Guns and Fish?**
A: No, make sure you level pets evenly, merging a 4th in the inventory to level up your main 3.

embeds.title: :Trip: Trip (Stage 35)
embeds.description:
-# 📖 [Mega Guide](guide:hunt-pets-trips)
**Q: Do I lose my pet stats when they are on a trip?**
A: No, however you cannot merge them until they have come back.

**Q: What happens if I do a 16hr trip at the end of the day?**
A: You can claim the trip the next day, or in a week if you want, you just can't merge or use those pets for another trip until you do.

**Q: What's the max level for Trip Abilities?**
A: 51, the cost increases by 2 each level, capping at 50 for Lv25.

**Q: What happens after 100% Skip Stage?**
A: Currently nothing, extra Skip Stage past 100% does not allow a 2nd stage to be skipped.

**Q: Does Skip Stage work offline?**
A: No, not yet at least.

embeds.title: :Diamond: Mine (Stage 4)
embeds.description:
-# 📖 [Mega Guide](guide:daily-modes-missions-mine-raid)
**Q: What is the best weapon for Mine?**
A: Blast, low level Blasts may not reach the ATK SPD cap.

**Q: How do I destroy all the Stones?**
A: Starting out you will not be able to, as you get more movement speed you will eventually be able to AFK and clear it 100%.

embeds.title: :Raid: Raid (Stage 40)
embeds.description:
-# 📖 [Mega Guide](guide:daily-modes-missions-mine-raid)
**Q: How do I use my Raid Gems :RaidGem:?**
A: Click on the Star above your gun in Gun or Raid.

**Q: How should I spend my Raid Gems?**
A: Focus on 1 enhance slot until Lv20. Then move onto the next.

**Q: What's the highest enhancement level?**
A: 20.

**Q: Is the helper for one season or permanent?**
A: Only one season.

**Q: How do I raise the Enhance Level of the helper?**
A: It matches your lowest Enhance Slot Level.

**Q: Does my Enhance Slot Level disappear if I merge my gun?**
A: No, the Enhance Levels are tied to the 1st, 2nd or 3rd slot, changing guns has no effect.

embeds.title: :Diamond: Diamond Spending & Earning
embeds.description:
-# 📖 [Mega Guide](guide:diamonds-earning-spending)
**Q: Are Gem game offers worth it?**
A: No, the time it takes to play them and earn small amount of Diamonds, you're better off actively playing and rebirthing for more power.

**Q: What do I buy next with Diamonds?**
A: Follow the [Diamond Spending Guide](guide:diamonds-earning-spending).

embeds.title: :Money: Real Money Purchases
embeds.description:
-# 📖 [Mega Guide](guide:real-money-purchases-guide)
**Q: Do I need to spend money?**
A: No, there will be a lot of ads however and you'll move at a slower pace than low spenders but if that's okay with your playstyle you can be F2P.

**Q: Is this game P2W?**
A: Not exactly, there are ways to boost progress in the first 2 weeks but afterwards most progression is tied to Rebirthing, a time locked system that can't easily be paid through.

embeds.title: 💬 Other
embeds.description:
**Q: Is this good progress for X Days?**
A: Yes, comparison is the thief of joy. All players will move at different speeds, you can check the Mega Guide to see if you’re playing efficiently.

**Q: How do I contact support?**
A: Top left :Settings:, click the Support button.

**Q: Are there any codes?**
A: No, some will probably be added in the future.

embeds.title: 💡 Tips
embeds.description:
- 💡 Save and force quit app when going idle, sometimes the game doesn't register offline progress when you just switch apps.
- 💡 If you only buy one thing, get No Reward Ads, very good value for long term players and changes the feel of the game.
- 💡 DO NOT buy Pets with Diamonds, only Hunt Gems. You will get enough for 5x XXX Pets.
- 💡 Play online if you want to progress the fastest.
- 💡 Always merge guns to the highest tier.
- 💡 Follow 5:1 Power to Money Cost Ratio.
